memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Just as it pleased the Lord to make you prosper and increase in number, so it will please him to ruin and destroy you. You will be uprooted from the land you are entering to possess. Then the Lord will scatter you among all nations, from one end of the earth to the other. There you will worship other gods... Among those nations you will find no repose, no resting place for the sole of your foot." — Deut 28:63-65 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
These are heavy words: the same God who delighted to bless would, in the face of persistent rebellion, bring judgment. And the exile is named again — scattered among the nations, with "no resting place for the sole of your foot." A restless, wandering, homeless existence is the picture. It is the opposite of the settled rest God had promised in the land.

That phrase — "no resting place" — captures something profound about life apart from God. When we turn from Him, we lose our true rest. We wander, restless and unsettled, searching for a home our souls cannot find anywhere but in Him. As one early Christian famously prayed, our hearts are restless until they rest in God.

We do not read this as our covenant curse, but the deep human truth remains. Every restless heart, every unsettled soul chasing peace in things that cannot give it, echoes this ancient warning. There is no rest for us apart from God.

And this is exactly the rest Jesus offers. "Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest," He said (Matt 11:28). Where sin leaves us with "no resting place," Christ becomes our resting place. The wandering soul finds a home in Him. If you are weary and restless today, the invitation still stands. Come to Jesus, and find the rest your heart has been searching for.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Am I seeking rest anywhere other than in God?
2. Where do I feel restless or unsettled, and have I brought it to Christ?
3. What would it mean to truly find my rest in Jesus?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord Jesus, my heart is restless until it rests in You. When I wander searching for peace, draw me back to Yourself. Thank You for being the resting place my soul longs for. Amen.
